exposure: PH type (Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension (PAH), PH associated with Left Heart Disease (PH-LHD))
cohort: The study included 118 pregnant women with pulmonary hypertension identified from medical records at a single hospital between July 2017 and December 2021.
finding: Severe pulmonary hypertension and high NT-proBNP levels are strongly correlated with increased maternal mortality rates in pregnant women.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were high across all three PH severity groups.
